company: The Aerospace Corporation
title: RF/Microwave Engineer - Senior Member of Technical Staff
location: El Segundo, CA
field: -
description:
At the Mission Payloads Division (MPD), we are pioneers in remote sensing systems that guide our country’s space enterprise.
[under: Why We're Different] The selected candidate will be required to work full time on-site at our facility at El Segundo, CA.
[under: What You’ll Be Doing] - Model complex systems – Generate performance budgets and run circuit simulations (ADS, Microwave Office) that predict how systems will behave before a single component is soldered
[under: Minimum Requirements] - Modeling of microwave and/or millimeter-wave circuits using ADS OR Microwave Office
[under: Minimum Requirements] - Experience with manual and remote operation of network analyzers, oscilloscopes, arbitrary waveform generators and other instrumentation
[under: Ways We Reward Our Employees] - Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options
